excerpt: Injiniyan prompt yana tsara shigar LLM a lokacin inference — ba tare da sabunta nauyi ba. Labarin yana rufe dabarun da aka tabbatar suna da inganci a 2024: zero-shot task framing (Brown et al., 2020), chain-of-thought reasoning (Wei et al., 2022), self-consistency sampling (Wang et al., 2022), ReAct agent loops (Yao et al., 2022), haɗarin indirect prompt injection (Greshake et al., 2023), da ƙirar RAG daga ayyukan kuɗi.
